title: AI Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What this role is about

AI has arrived in the German Mittelstand. The distance between a convincing demo and a system a department trusts every single day is still large — and it gets closed by work that almost nobody does properly: defining what "good" concretely means, building the system toward it, measuring whether it hits, and iterating until it holds.

That is what you do:

You don't start from zero. You usually get a real starting point, often a golden data set from the department of a German Mittelstand company: real cases, each with the result an experienced expert would deliver. Your job is to build a system that reaches that result reliably, to bring it into people's working day through an interface they can actually use, and to be able to prove that it works.

Tasks

You typically work on two to three customer projects in parallel.

80% Building: The core of the role

  • Derive a defensible definition of "correct" from reference data, and build an eval that measures it
  • Design and build the AI system itself: model and provider choice, context and prompt design, structured outputs, tool calling, agent/workflow logic, retrieval where it earns its place — and deterministic logic where an LLM isn't needed.
  • Do error analysis and iterate deliberately instead of guessing — and demonstrate the improvement
  • Build guardrails, escalation paths and monitoring, so the system doesn't fail loudly and confidently
  • Build the production interface that goes with it: review screens, approvals, human-in-the-loop — in Next.js and TypeScript, not a throwaway prototype
  • Roll the solution out and keep it running + improve it as AI advances

20% Communication: Mostly internal

  • Capture and pass on your state in a structured way: what is built, what was measured, what is still open — in writing, without anyone having to ask
  • Explain complex technical matters so that the project lead and colleagues without an AI background can decide on a sound basis
  • Raise questions, blockers and wrong assumptions early instead of collecting them until the next meeting
  • Occasionally demonstrate or explain a result at the customer yourself

Your standard is not "it's built". Your standard is: it is demonstrably good, it gets used, and it creates real value for the customer.

What this role is not

Three boundaries and all three exist to protect your build time.

  • You don't own the customer. The relationship, the workshops and the conversations with management sit with the project lead. You see customers occasionally — when a result needs to be demonstrated or explained — not weekly.
  • You don't run the project — and it does get run. We work with structured project management: scope and deadlines are defined up front and actively managed, so you know what you're delivering and by when, and your work stays plannable instead of absorbing whatever shifted this week. Very little ticket boards, no worklogs, no status lists on your side. What we do need: that your state is legible to everyone else at any time, without anyone having to ask.
  • You don't work inside our customers' infrastructure — no SAP customizing, no system administration, no legacy integration as your core work.

Your first 90 days

  • Weeks 1–3: You work inside two running projects, get to know our stack and our eval practice, and take over your first AI ise case of your own.
  • Weeks 4–8: You own a complete use case — from the reference data set through the evals to the production interface — and you record results and measurements so that the project lead can represent them without you.
  • After three months: You build your use cases independently, decide on approach and scope, and are the person on the project team who translates technical topics for everyone else.

Requirements

Important

  • You have built an AI solution that real users used in production — not just a prototype, not just a concept.
  • You know how to engineer production LLM systems: context and prompt design, model selection, structured outputs, tool calling, failure handling, latency/cost trade-offs — and you know when a deterministic component beats an LLM.
  • You work eval-driven: you define up front what a good result is, you measure systematically, and you don't ship on gut feeling. Whether that runs on Langfuse, Promptfoo, Arize Phoenix or your own spreadsheet is up to you; that you do it at all is not.
  • You have built a system in which AI agents plan and execute tasks: tool calling, structured outputs, human-in-the-loop.
  • You build production frontend: React and Next.js (App Router, Server Components), TypeScript. Not just demos, but error states, permissions, and the edges where prototypes fall apart.
  • You can ship and operate your own solution: Docker, deployment, logging, cost control.
  • You can explain a complex technical topic so that someone without an AI background can decide soundly afterwards — in writing just as well as in conversation.
  • You work in a structured way internally: your status, your measurements and your open points are written down and findable, without anyone having to chase you.
  • Coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor) as part of your daily work
  • English at working level. The working language on this role is English, meaning Slack, meetings, code, PRs, and the write-ups that go with them.
  • You can work in Germany full-time. A student visa with a day limit doesn't cover this role.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in delivery projects.

Highly valuable

  • German. Our customers are German Mittelstand, and the occasional demo there runs in German. Without it, the project lead covers that part — but it makes life easier, for you and for us.
  • Experience with a production AI SDK layer (e.g. Vercel AI SDK), streaming architectures, several providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral)
  • Evaluation pipelines and feedback loops as a topic in their own right, not a by-product
  • Using retrieval where it earns its place — and recognising when you don't need it
  • Experience with customers or business departments in the German Mittelstand
  • Confidence on GDPR and EU hosting questions
  • Workflow orchestration with n8n or something comparable

Not required

  • A computer science degree
  • Model training, fine-tuning, classical machine learning
  • MLOps, Kubernetes, data engineering pipelines
  • Ten years of experience with a three-year-old framework ;)

What matters to us more than a perfect CV

We're not looking for the most elegant architecture, the most impressive stack, or the solution that demos best. We're looking for the simplest solution that demonstrably solves the use case — and for someone who knows the difference and holds it even when the more elaborate option would be more fun.

If your first question on a new project is what infrastructure we should set up, we're probably not a fit. If your first question is what we actually want to measure this thing against: then we are.

You'll fit here particularly well if …

  • … you'd rather ship something demonstrably useful in two weeks than something complete in three months.
  • … you can sink your teeth into an error rate until you understand where it comes from.
  • … you say when a use case isn't worth it, even when it already sounds sold.

Benefits

What you can expect

  • Delivery that doesn't end at slides. You see projects from discovery through to go-live, and you build the solution yourself.
  • Ownership without micromanagement. Clear goals, no step-by-step instructions. Good arguments change decisions, regardless of who makes them.
  • Visible impact. Short paths, flat structure, no sign-off loops for the sake of form. Within a few weeks you see whether something works.
  • Becoming genuinely AI-native. Agents in production, not in a notebook — and evaluating what actually holds up, on systems with real users. Full AI stack: Claude, OpenAI, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, and whatever else your project needs.
  • Remote, but not anonymous. Our team works mostly out of Berlin, with a team day every Wednesday at the EDGE Coworking by Hauptbahnhof. Otherwise flexible remote, with occasional appointments at customers.

Who we are

Lucid Labs is an AI-first studio for applied AI in the German Mittelstand. We don't just advise companies on which use cases to pick — we build and operate the solutions that run in their processes. Founder Marek Janetzke previously co-built Flightright and stayed with it through to the exit.

Who you'll work with

You won't be the only AI engineer here. You work alongside colleagues who build the same kind of systems you do — people to think a hard problem through with, to have an approach reviewed before you commit to it, and to borrow a solution from when someone has already solved it once. Technical decisions get argued out, not handed down.

Our stack

  • Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
  • AI: for example Vercel AI SDK, provider-flexible (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral), Claude Skills, agentic workflows, n8n
  • Data & deployment: PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM, Docker, Vercel, Elestio on EU servers
  • Day-to-day: Cursor, Claude Code, pnpm, Node.js, GitHub Actions

How to apply

Please send us two things:

  1. your CV
  2. one example, in two paragraphs at most: an AI solution you built that real users used.

Briefly describe:

  • what you used to decide the result was good enough
  • how you measured it
  • what didn't work on the first attempt, and why
  • what you changed as a result

Please don't include confidential information from previous employers or customers. The second part matters more to us than the first. You don't need a cover letter.

We're looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote / German-Speaking)
description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

  • Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

  • Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

title: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)

Du kennst den Unterschied zwischen einer geschalteten Anzeige und einer funktionierenden Recruiting-Strategie? Und du willst nicht nur eine Position im Haus besetzen, sondern die Personalgewinnung ganzer Unternehmen verantworten? Dann lies weiter.

Im klassischen Inhouse-Recruiting arbeitest du an den Stellen, die dir zugewiesen werden, mit dem Budget, das jemand anderes verhandelt hat. Bei uns läuft es umgekehrt: Du entscheidest, welche Unternehmen du gewinnst, wie ihre Recruiting-Strategie aussieht und über welche Kanäle die Besetzung läuft. Beratung, Umsetzung und Ergebnis liegen in einer Hand – deiner.

Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung im Zentrum von Bielefeld. Wir machen Arbeitgeber sichtbar und liefern ihnen planbar passende Bewerbungen – über datengetriebene Kampagnen statt Zufallstreffer. Fachkräftemangel und demografische Entwicklung lassen diesen Markt jedes Jahr weiter wachsen.

Deine Verantwortung

Strategie und Beratung

  • Du analysierst, warum die Personalgewinnung eines Unternehmens nicht liefert – Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Kanäle, Prozessgeschwindigkeit.

  • Daraus entwickelst du eine belastbare Recruiting-Strategie und stellst sie den Entscheidern vor.

  • Du gewinnst neue Kunden aktiv: über Telefon, Direktansprache und Empfehlungen.

Kampagnen und Besetzung

  • Du planst Recruiting-Kampagnen, steuerst sie über die Laufzeit und justierst anhand der Zahlen nach.

  • Du prüfst eingehende Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche zur Vorauswahl und gestaltest eine Candidate Experience, die im Gedächtnis bleibt.

  • Bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung bleibt das Projekt in deiner Hand.

Daten und Weiterentwicklung

  • Du arbeitest sauber im CRM, kennst deine Kennzahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

  • Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung schärfst du unsere Methodik weiter.

Dein Profil

  • Recruiting-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Zielgruppenansprache, Kanalauswahl und Prozessgestaltung zusammenwirken – ob aus Agentur, Personaldienstleistung oder Inhouse.

  • Beratungsstärke: Du triffst mit deinen Fragen den Kern, denkst in Lösungen und erklärst sie so, dass Entscheider mitgehen.

  • Vertriebsbereitschaft: Neue Kunden zu gewinnen gehört für dich dazu und schreckt dich nicht ab.

  • Zahlenaffinität: Du liest Kampagnendaten, erkennst Muster und handelst danach.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du steuerst dich selbst, hältst nach Rückschlägen Kurs und misst dich an Ergebnissen.

  • Zum Hintergrund: Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg – wir schauen auf Können und Antrieb, nicht auf den Titel. Erfahrung im Recruiting ist willkommen, aber nichts, was wir dir nicht beibringen könnten.

Unser Angebot

  • Vergütung ohne Obergrenze: Fixgehalt als sichere Basis, dazu eine Provision, die nicht gedeckelt ist.

  • Unbefristet vom ersten Tag an: Wir planen langfristig – in einem Markt, der stabil wächst.

  • Klarer Entwicklungspfad: Recruiter, Junior Consultant, Senior Consultant. Das Tempo bestimmst du.

  • Einarbeitung mit Struktur: Umfassendes Onboarding, Trainings zu Recruiting, Beratung und Vertrieb, dazu feste Feedbackrunden.

  • Ausstattung auf Niveau: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Hardware – mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.

  • Fitness auf unsere Kosten: Premium-Mitgliedschaft im Studio deiner Wahl.

  • Gut versorgt: Siebträgerkaffee von Julius Meinl, ausgesuchte Tees, flexibles Mittagsangebot über Meyer Menü.

  • Flache Hierarchie: Leistungsorientiert und kollegial, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

Der Ablauf

  1. Bewerben in zwei Minuten – Lebenslauf genügt, kein Anschreiben nötig.

  2. Telefonat zum Kennenlernen – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

  3. Persönliches Gespräch in unserem Büro in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.

Wenn du Recruiting nicht abarbeiten, sondern gestalten willst: Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Head of Product (all genders)
description:
Kertos Intro

Kertos is the fastest-growing compliance startup in Europe.

Following our €14M Series A, backed by leading VCs and business angels, we are building the compliance engine for Europe – faster, smarter, and more automated than ever.
With customers like Enpal, Flink, Personio, and Blacklane, leading companies trust our AI-native platform that automates compliance, scales effortlessly, and makes organizations audit-ready in record time.

The market is growing by 20% every year, fueled by regulations like GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and the AI Act. We are perfectly positioned to establish Kertos as the European compliance champion.

There has never been a better moment to join our team.

Come shape the future of compliance in Europe with us.


Your purpose at Kertos

As Head of Product, you own Kertos's product vision and roadmap, and you're joining at a genuinely pivotal moment. The category is being redrawn: compliance is shifting from software as a service to service as software, where AI and automation do the work wherever they can and our compliance experts focus on the judgment calls that still need a human. Few companies get to shape a product at the point where that shift is actually happening. You will.

That means the roadmap in front of you is wide open. There are more good directions to take the product than we can pursue at once, across the segments we serve today and the ones we're growing into, and a real part of the job is choosing where to place the bets. You'll work closely with our compliance experts to understand exactly what clients need, and decide with your team and engineering where the line between automation and human judgment sits today, with the mandate to push it forward quarter after quarter as AI takes on more of the work.

This role sits at the center of the product organization and value creation. You set the roadmap across squads, and you lead and grow the product team, partnering closely with our compliance experts and building around their knowledge, their needs, and their day-to-day work. You're accountable for the roadmap, for how the product team operates, and for outcomes clients can feel directly: time saved, risk reduced, audits passed.

Your responsibilities

  • Set the product vision, defining where Kertos product goes next, the shift from compliance software clients operate themselves to a service that delivers compliance outcomes for them, and turn that vision into a roadmap built around client value, not just feature velocity.
  • Partner closely with our compliance experts to learn what actually creates value for them and our customers, and work with our Development Team to turn that expertise into a product that makes their work faster and clients' outcomes better.
  • Continue to develop and mentor the product team as the team scales, set the standards for how they run discovery and shipping, and make sure they grow into stronger PMs under you.
  • Lead discovery working closely with compliance experts, design and engineering to understand problems deeply, validate ideas with real clients before building, and ship improvements that move a client's compliance outcome.
  • Understand needs of customers, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing so product bets translate into revenue, retention, and measurable value for clients, especially as features move from "helps you do compliance" to "does the compliance work for you."
  • Own the roadmap, setting priorities independently, and aligning them with technical leads, our customer advisory board, key clients, and the leadership team.
  • Use data to define what success looks like for each initiative in terms clients would recognize, such as “time saved”, “risk mitigated”, “time to audit readiness”, and work with Marketing and Customer Success to turn usage data into the next round of decisions.



The skills, motivation, and mentality you should bring

  • You've led product strategy in B2B SaaS as a Head of Product or similar, at a startup, scale-up, or an agile team inside a larger company and ideally have taken a product from idea through GA more than once.
  • You've hired, mentored, and managed product managers before, and know how to set clear expectations and give feedback that actually helps.
  • You successfully partner with compliance or legal experts who aren't engineers and turn their knowledge into product requirements.
  • You are experienced in shipping no code AI agents or other autonomous product features.
  • You are an ambitious and driven high-performer that wants to have a high impact on changing how compliance work gets done, excited about new user flows and AI-driven automation and is excited to take our compliance service & software product to series B ready.
  • You can successfully turn complex technical and compliance topics into clear direction for engineering, sales, leadership, and customers in both English and German (C1 minimum).
  • Big plus if you bring technical engineering expertise that helps you to discuss frontend, backend, and cloud architecture. 
  • Familiarity with GRC, information security, or privacy topics would be a great plus point, too.


Why Kertos

  • You are Kertos: Don’t like something? Could be done better? You have the freedom to push things forward and contribute to making Kertos a great place to work
  • Unique opportunity: Join the growing team of one of Europe’s most promising early stages companies and to work directly with our COO Joe
  • European funding in the millions: The EU has funded our AI research with a total of over 2 million euros
  • Regular Feedback: We foster an open feedback culture and support your growth with regular 1-on-1 meetings
  • Full Flexibility: Whether at the Berlin office, our Munich HQ or at your home office – we are flexible, and you'll be happy
  • Keep growing: To boost your professional and personal growth, we provide you with a Personal Development Budget of 1.500€ per year
  • Cutting Edge Technology: Leading VCs have invested in our vision to revolutionize how compliance measures are handled sustainably
  • Mental Health: We've partnered with nilo to prioritize your well-being, offering personalized mental health support for all employees
  • For Sports Enthusiasts: We subsidize your Wellpass membership for your physical fitness for a better work-life balance
  • Steep learning curve: With us you get full responsibility from day 1, push topics forward independently and thus learn a lot
  • Strong onboarding: No idea about compliance and its automation? No problem, we'll turn you into an expert and provide you with an onboarding buddy
  • Teamwork Makes the Dream Work: We are a strong team that supports each other, and we also have a lot of fun together beyond work and across different locations


Sounds like you are the one we’ve been looking for?

Perfect, let's have a chat! Just send in your CV. We are excited to meet you soon.
In case you have any questions, feel free to reach out to our People & Culture team. We're happy to answer all your questions.

  • Optimizing inference for low latency, high resolution, and cost efficiency

  • Running controlled ablations and experiments to drive high-signal modeling decisions

You will be expected to move fast, run multiple hypotheses in parallel, identify signal early, and focus on outcomes rather than exploration for its own sake.

Our stack

  • Python, PyTorch, CUDA

  • Sequence parallelism

  • AWS, SLURM, Docker

  • GitHub, CI/CD pipelines

Who you are

  • You operate independently but collaborate actively across teams

Why join us?

  • Tackle hard problems in scaling, stability, and controllability

title: Senior Manager, Regulatory Inspections and Strategic Response
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role


This is a newly created role sitting at the centre of some of Checkout.com's most sensitive and consequential regulatory moments. Reporting to the Director of External Affairs, the Senior Manager, Regulatory Inspections and Strategic Response will manage Checkout's most important regulatory situations end-to-end, whether planned or unplanned.

In practice, that means two connected mandates. The first is the planned, cyclical work of running Checkout's regulatory inspections and examinations — a methodical, deadline-driven discipline that forms the steady-state core of the role. The second is the unplanned work: leading the response to the exceptional, time-critical and commercially sensitive situations that require a calm cross-functional leader to bring them to a resolution.

You will be the person the business turns to when a regulator opens an inspection, and when a sensitive cross-functional situation needs to be stabilised quickly and handled with judgement. You will bring order and momentum to ambiguous, high-stakes matters, coordinating across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Commercial, Product, Tech and Communications, and you will own the strategy and the outcome.

This is a role with a clear mandate to build. You will establish the function, set the operating model, and over the course of 2027 hire and develop a small team of specialists to scale it.

What you'll do

Own regulatory inspections end-to-end

  • Act as the single accountable owner for Checkout's regulatory inspections, examinations and skilled-person reviews across the group's regulated entities.

  • Run each inspection as a programme: set the strategy and narrative, build and manage the timeline, coordinate evidence gathering, quality-assure submissions, and prepare and rehearse subject-matter experts and senior stakeholders for regulator engagement.

  • Serve as the primary point of coordination between the business and the regulator.

  • Protect the company's position throughout — controlling disclosures to what is necessary and appropriate, safeguarding confidential supervisory information, and ensuring the executive team and boards are informed at the right moments.

  • Drive continuous improvement by running post-mortems after each engagement and acting on any findings.

Lead the response to sensitive, escalated situations

  • Lead the response to the exceptional, time-critical situations that carry material regulatory, financial or reputation risk and need to be handled at pace.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: establish the facts, set out the risk and the options for senior decision-makers, secure decisions, assign actions, and maintain momentum until matters are resolved.

  • Work in close partnership with the Director of External Affairs on the most sensitive matters, acting as a trusted extension of the role.

Build the function

  • Establish the operating model and playbooks for a new function within Checkout.com

  • Hire, develop and lead a small team

What we are looking for

  • Significant experience in managing regulatory inspections and engagement - ideally within payments or fintech

  • A methodical, meticulous approach to project management

  • A track record of keeping calm under pressure

  • Highly responsive, solutions-oriented and comfortable operating with ambiguity

  • Commercially pragmatic, with the ability to weigh regulatory and reputational risk against business objectives and to take considered, well-reasoned decisions

  • Excellent stakeholder management: credible with regulators and auditors, trusted by executives, and effective at mobilising colleagues across functions and geographies.

  • People management experience, or clear readiness to build and lead a team

  • Impeccable written communication

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

title: Technical Operations Analyst
description:
About the Team

At OpenAI, our User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO) team helps protect our products and users from abuse, fraud, safety risks, and other forms of misuse. We operate at the front line of real-world safety and risk management, translating user and operational signals into timely decisions, effective interventions, and improvements to our systems.

Within USRO, Risk Incubation & Systems builds the analytics, automation, monitoring, quality mechanisms, and operating systems that help teams identify risk, make sound decisions, and scale safely.

Our work spans emerging-risk detection, operational measurement, workflow automation, quality systems, launch readiness, and decision-support tools. We partner closely with operational teams as well as Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Safety, Legal, and Support to identify high-leverage opportunities and build practical systems that improve outcomes.

About the Role

We are hiring a Technical Operations Analyst to solve ambiguous, high-impact operational problems using data, technical tools, and strong judgment. You will work as an experienced individual contributor across USRO, moving from problem definition through analysis, workflow design, implementation, measurement, and handoff.

The scope is intentionally broad and may span emerging-risk detection, operational quality, automation, launch readiness, and other priority programs. You will be expected to move between different problem areas as organizational needs evolve.

This is a hands-on role. You should be comfortable querying and validating data, building dashboards and lightweight automations, using AI tools to accelerate work, and working directly with operators and technical partners to turn incomplete information into practical systems.

Your work may also include data and operational monitoring issues for major cloud deployment partnerships—for example, validating pipelines and safety signals, investigating anomalies or discrepancies, improving reporting and escalation mechanisms, and documenting data limitations so partner teams can act with confidence.

Location / work model: London, UK; hybrid, 3 days/week in-office.

Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, judgment, and resilience are essential.

In This Role, You Will

  • Independently scope ambiguous operational problems and frontier & emerging risks, and turn them into clear analyses, workflows, tools, or decision systems.

  • Analyze large and complex datasets to identify patterns, data-quality gaps, operational blind spots, and source-of-truth issues.

  • Build and maintain dashboards, monitoring, alerts, recurring reporting, and workflow automations.

  • Develop systems for detecting and assessing emerging risks, including classifier, evaluation, labeling, and human-review feedback loops.

  • Support major cloud deployments and partnerships by validating data pipelines and safety signals, investigating anomalies, and improving operational monitoring, reporting, and escalation.

  • Can use AI and LLM tools to accelerate real workflows while independently validating outputs and managing failure modes.

  • Exercise sound judgment in scaled operations, including queues, escalations, reviewer workflows, capacity, quality, and incident response.

  • Move quickly in ambiguous environments, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and create structure without waiting for perfect requirements.

  • Communicate complex findings clearly to technical, operational, and leadership audiences and drive work through cross-functional partners.

  • Experience supporting cloud, enterprise, or privacy-preserving deployments with constrained data access or specialized monitoring requirements.

  • Experience with classifiers, evaluations, golden datasets, labeling programs, reviewer calibration, or model-quality measurement.

  • Experience with Python, notebooks, data-pipeline troubleshooting, or other lightweight technical development.

  • Experience designing quality systems or workflows that involve vendors, BPOs, or distributed operational teams.

At deepset, we’re on a mission to make custom AI solutions accessible to every organization. With Haystack, thousands of developers build advanced LLM applications every day, while our enterprise-ready AI Platform helps companies turn large language models into business value. You’ll collaborate with top-tier tech talent, tackle meaningful challenges, and help transform complex AI into solutions that are simple, powerful, and ready for the real world.

What you will do

  • Experience with enterprise security reviews for AI or data products

  • Experience converting open-source users into enterprise customers

Founded in 2018, deepset builds open and enterprise-grade tools that help teams build AI with purpose. description:
About Aurora Solar

Aurora is on a mission to create a future of solar for all. Our award-winning software puts the power of data and technology into the hands of every solar professional to make solar adoption simple and predictable. Our software has designed millions of solar projects so far, empowering solar companies to sell, design, and install residential and commercial solar arrays accurately, seamlessly, and at scale. 


We’ve been named one of "The Best Remote Companies" by BuiltIn.com and have been recognized for the second time as a Certified Green Business (CGB) with the city of San Francisco. We’re in this together to support the world’s transition to solar.

Aurora's European Account Management team partners with customers across Germany, the UK, and France after the initial sale to ensure they achieve meaningful business outcomes with the Aurora platform. The team is responsible for driving product adoption, retaining and expanding existing customer relationships, and helping customers unlock the full value of Aurora's solutions.

Account Managers work closely with solar installers, EPCs, and developers to understand their evolving needs and align Aurora’s software capabilities with their growth strategies. Commercial instinct and deep product knowledge sit at the center of how we operate, and we use both to help customers scale while pushing the energy transition forward in Europe.

We collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Support, and Enablement so our customers always have the resources, insights, and partnership they need to win.

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic, customer-focused Senior Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of Aurora customers across Europe, primarily in Germany, the UK, and France. You'll drive retention, adoption, and expansion by building strong relationships with customer stakeholders and connecting Aurora's solutions to their business goals.

As a trusted advisor, you'll identify opportunities to deepen product usage, introduce new solutions, and ensure customers are seeing real returns on their investment in Aurora. You'll partner closely with Sales Engineering, Implementation, Product, and Marketing to deliver a seamless experience and support long-term growth.

This role calls for a balance of strategic account planning, commercial ownership, and operational discipline. You'll be comfortable navigating complex customer environments across multiple markets, managing renewals and negotiations, and using data to drive decisions.

This position is hybrid from London, UK.

Your Impact

  • Own and grow a portfolio of Aurora customers across Europe, driving retention, adoption, and expansion across Aurora and HelioScope

  • Lead renewals and commercial negotiations, including early renewals, amendments, and custom pricing structures

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans with customer stakeholders to achieve measurable usage growth and lasting partnership value

  • Build pipeline within your book of business by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities through proactive outreach and marketing-qualified leads

  • Use product usage data, UV metrics, and customer insights to forecast expansion, flag churn risk, and get ahead of it

  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic conversations that align on goals, adoption milestones, and ROI

  • Collaborate across Product, Sales Engineering, Implementation, Support, and Marketing to deliver solutions that meet customer needs and create new ones

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or sales within SaaS, energy technology, or a related field

  • A proven track record of growing a customer portfolio through renewals, upsells, and cross-sells

  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience negotiating contracts, renewals, and pricing structures

  • The ability to build strategic relationships with executive stakeholders and navigate complex customer organizations

  • Experience using data and customer insights to drive adoption, identify risk, and develop account growth strategies

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; you work well across teams and make things happen

  • Strong organizational discipline, including managing pipeline and renewals in CRM systems like Salesforce

  • Professional proficiency in English; German or French language skills are a strong plus given our core European markets

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in solar, clean energy, or climate tech

  • Familiarity with solar design platforms or project development workflows

  • Experience managing consumption-based SaaS models

  • Background in high-growth or remote-first technology companies

  • Experience working across multiple European markets (Germany, UK, France)

Benefits: We strive to be the best place for the best people, and that includes the benefits and perks we offer. We provide a holistic program to support physical, emotional, financial, and social needs. This includes work-from-home stipends for home office setup, internet, and co-working spaces. Service providers will receive flexible paid time off including statutory vacation and sick leave, with additional parental leave available. Service providers receive a standard laptop and an annual healthcare budget through AXA.

Where Aurorans are: Aurora currently has teams within the US, Canada, Poland, and Germany with additional locations on the horizon. We’re united in our work to support the world’s transition to solar!

Aurora is dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workforce of people who believe in and are passionate about creating a future of solar energy for all. title: Project Manager
description:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

As a Project Manager at Sona, you'll lead the coordination of an Implementation Pod consisting of a Solutions Architect and a Solutions Specialist, and together you'll own a portfolio of enterprise implementations for our customers.

You'll run implementations of Sona's products (HR, Scheduling, Payroll, LMS & ATS) end to end, ensuring delivery meets our scope commitments, budgets and timelines, all while providing an exceptional experience for our customers. You'll partner closely with senior stakeholders from our customers and internally across our Commercial, Product and Customer teams. We're a growing business, so you'll also need to thrive in a fast-evolving environment and be a strong advocate for clarity and communication.


Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver projects on time, within scope and budget, maintaining the highest quality standards.

  • Manage project risks, dependencies and scope, communicating mitigations and changes clearly to all stakeholders.

  • Act as the primary customer advocate, building strong relationships and managing expectations throughout delivery.

  • Coordinate internal teams, vendors and customers to ensure successful outcomes and efficient resource deployment.

  • Produce clear, consistent documentation and status reports, escalating risks where required.

  • Support our Land and Expand approach by driving strong customer partnerships and early value realisation.

  • Continuously improve project processes and tools to enhance delivery speed, quality and customer satisfaction.

Requirements

  • Proven success delivering enterprise software implementation projects on time, within budget and scope.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with C-level executives.

  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills, able to influence without direct authority.

  • Strategic thinker with strong risk management, planning and prioritisation capabilities.

  • Calm, organised and results-driven under pressure, with excellent time management.

  • Confident in presenting, reporting and managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.

  • Bonus: experience with workforce management or HR software, experience managing customers in a frontline or operationally complex industry.

Benefits

  • Salary: £70,000 - £80,000 per annum

  • Hybrid working pattern (2+ days per week in our London office, plus customer travel across the UK)

title: Senior Software Engineer | Identity and Access Management | Full-Stack
description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Identity and Access Management team. Owning DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, account and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries — builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your responsibilities

  • Own the Identity Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our identity stack. You will own business-critical systems from the initial problem definition through to architectural design, deployment, and production reliability. You measure success by user impact, not just pull requests merged

  • Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You understand that authentication and authorization systems cannot fail. You build for reliability and maintainability, while delivering a user-friendly experience. You will lead incident response, and continuously raise the bar on code quality and operational health

  • Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams - other product teams, Product Management and Support. You will lead designs, scoping, shaping, and solving hard product and technical challenges in collaboration with your team and other engineers

  • Drive Technical Pragmatism: Whether using our core stack (C#/.NET Core, Kubernetes, Postgres) or exploring new tools, you choose the technology that solves the customer problem most effectively, ensuring long-term maintainability over short-term trends. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

Qualities we look for

  • Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, monitor the systems in production, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn

  • A "System Thinker" Mindset: You don't just know syntax; you understand failure modes, system boundaries, and how your code impacts the broader architecture at scale. You can design systems that deliver high availability for our millions of users.

  • Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems and distributed architectures, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong system design is core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/Javascript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement

title: Senior Enterprise Architect (Associate, Contract)
description:
Intelance works with UK organisations that need clear, practical decisions about technology. We are building a trusted group of senior associates to lead short enterprise architecture engagements. This project based contract role is for someone who can understand how decisions are made, find where ownership or information is unclear, and give senior leaders a plan they can use.

Tasks

You will:

  • Lead current state enterprise architecture reviews from the first interview to the executive readout.
  • Interview senior business and technology leaders, then explain the findings in plain English.
  • Map how decisions are made across applications, data, integration, security, operations and change.
  • Test early findings against real decisions, documents and other evidence.
  • Identify unclear ownership, duplicated effort, avoidable risk and important dependencies.
  • Design practical options, clear decision rights and a costed roadmap.
  • Produce board ready reports, diagrams and presentations.
  • Work with Intelance associates while owning the quality of the work and the client relationship.

Requirements

You must have:

  • At least 10 years of enterprise architecture, business architecture or technology governance experience.
  • Personally led a current state assessment from discovery through to an executive readout.
  • Experience interviewing and presenting to Board, COO, CIO or equivalent leaders.
  • Strong knowledge of applications, data, integration, security, operating models and technology governance.
  • Recent work in a law firm, professional services partnership, financial services firm or another regulated organisation.
  • Evidence that you can turn complex findings into clear written advice and practical decisions.
  • The confidence to challenge senior people calmly and work without depending on a large consulting team.
  • The right to work and contract in the UK without sponsorship.
  • Availability for remote work and occasional travel to London or other UK client sites.
  • The ability to meet Intelance checks for conflicts, references, confidentiality, information security and insurance.

TOGAF or a similar qualification is useful, but clear evidence of delivery matters more.

Benefits

  • £700 to £850 per day, excluding VAT, based on experience and the scope of each assignment.
  • Project based associate contract with no guaranteed minimum number of days.
  • Initial assignments are usually 10 to 20 days delivered over three to six weeks.
  • Mostly remote work with planned UK client travel when needed.
  • Direct access to the senior people making the decisions.
  • Further work may follow across enterprise architecture, AI governance, data and security.

Apply if you can lead the work yourself and produce clear outputs for senior leaders. We will review your application, hold a short fit call, and then complete references, conflict and contracting checks. We will not ask you to write a long unpaid proposal.

title: Manager, Account Executives (London)
AI Deployment Strategist, Critical and Sovereign Institutions - UK
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

As an AI Deployment Strategist, you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral's AI solutions, working closely with customers from strategic vision to production implementation.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI innovation, and hands-on deployment, ensuring customers achieve transformative outcomes. You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps, collaborate with the Applied AI team to deliver production solutions, and ensure smooth transitions from pre-sales to post-sales.

The Applied AI for Critical and Sovereign Institutions team is Mistral's specialized unit dedicated to delivering high-impact, secure AI solutions for institutions operating in highly regulated and strategic environments, including on-premise, disconnected, and air-gapped deployments. In this role, you will drive adoption inside sovereign institutions and critical infrastructure across the UK, partnering with senior leaders and mission owners under real operational, security, and compliance constraints to deliver projects with significant societal, operational, and strategic impact.

 

What you will do

 

Strategic discovery & vision setting

  • Lead executive-level and mission-owner workshops to identify challenges and opportunities where Mistral's AI can drive step-change improvements in strategic environments.

  • Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the "art of the possible" and a clear path to value within their regulatory and security perimeter.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases, quantify impact, and align solutions with mission and organizational objectives.

AI solution design & deployment

  • Architect end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral's models and platform into customer workflows and secure technical infrastructure (cloud, on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped).

  • Partner with the Applied AI team to design, prototype, and deploy AI solutions in production, ensuring scalability, security, and impact.

  • Own the execution of pilots and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology and paving the way for full-scale deployment.

Value realization & customer success

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding their AI strategy and ensuring they maximize the value of their investment in Mistral.

  • Monitor key performance indicators tied to operational and business outcomes, and communicate progress to executive sponsors.

  • Proactively identify expansion opportunities across use cases and units, building on initial successes to drive long-term partnerships.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral's internal teams, synthesizing feedback to influence product, science, and security roadmaps.

  • Develop reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks to scale go-to-market efforts and ensure consistent delivery excellence in regulated settings.

  • Travel (~30-60%) to foster deep client relationships and support on-site deployment.

     

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years in a client-facing strategic and technical role (e.g. data science consulting, value engineering, or technical sales).

  • A degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g. Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering).

  • Foundational knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science, with the credibility to advise both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python, JavaScript, or similar) to demonstrate value.

  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous challenges into actionable solutions.

  • Executive presence and communication skills to influence senior stakeholders (VP, C-level, mission owners).

  • Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment.

  • Comfort operating under security, compliance, and confidentiality constraints.

Nice to have

  • Experience with sales qualification frameworks (e.g. MEDDPICC) and value-based selling.

  • Experience deploying AI in regulated or sovereign environments (defence, public sector, critical infrastructure).

 

Security & compliance (vertical-specific):

  • Eligibility: must be a UK national

  • Clearable: must meet all requirements for UK national security vetting (e.g. Security Check (SC) and/or Developed Vetting (DV)), including no relevant criminal record and the ability to satisfy residency and background checks.

 

Why This Role Matters

 

You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact. By partnering with the Applied AI team, you’ll help turn strategic visions into production-ready solutions, making Mistral an indispensable partner for our customers.

 
 

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

title: Broker Development Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets.

  • Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential.

  • Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance.

  • Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business.

  • Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives.

  • Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems.

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs.

  • Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business.

PREFERABLE

  • Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting.

  • Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market.

  • Can embrace new technologies and products, with experience of successfully distributing these to brokers.

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

At Flock, we typically follow a hybrid working model involving a minimum of 3 days per week spent in the office, which is based in Central London, a few minutes walk from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Please note if your role involves visit to client sites and broker offices, then this can be substituted for office days.

ONE LAST THING..

Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want!

SpAItial is pioneering Physically-grounded World Models, a new AI paradigm designed to generate and reason about the appearance and physics of real and imagined environments. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the geometry of our world, and redefining how industries from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema create and interact with 3D environments.

You will own the recurring operations of the business, such as the monthly finance cycle, payroll, onboarding, vendors, filings, reporting, etc. You will work directly with our COO to facilitate smooth business ops and form the backbone of our company.

We are looking for someone diligent with attention to detail. Someone who keeps lists, who schedules the recurring thing the first time they see it, who notices that a deadline collides with a bank holiday before anyone else does. If you find satisfaction in a well-run cadence and a clean inbox, this role will suit you. It is hands-on, high-trust, and it will give you unusual visibility into how a frontier AI company gets built.

Responsibilities

  • Finance cycle with our accountants (reconciliations, management accounts, expenses, invoicing) and keep cash, burn, runway, and budget current and trustworthy.

  • People operations. Own payroll, onboarding, contracts, benefits, and employee documentation, and make sure a new joiner's first two weeks are excellent.

  • Advisors and compliance. Coordinate our payroll providers, pension, healthcare, banks, insurers, and legal counsel and keep the company in good standing across filings, VAT, statutory obligations, and insurance.

  • Vendors and spend. Own vendor relationships, contracts, and renewals, including significant compute and infrastructure commitments.

  • Workplace. Own our London office as a place people want to be, including management of space, equipment, suppliers, and support team events that make every day in the office worth it.

  • Process. Turn founder-led, manual workflows into documented processes that run without anyone remembering to run them.

  • Reporting. Prepare inputs for board materials, investor updates, and reporting packs, and work with our German colleagues and suppliers to keep things aligned

Key qualifications

  • 4+ years in operations, business operations, finance operations, or a similar role, including time in a startup or fast-moving technology company.

  • At least one role held long enough to live with the systems you built and fix them when they broke.

  • Exceptional diligence. You keep lists, you trust your system more than your memory, and you close things out, including the tedious ones.

  • Numerate and comfortable in spreadsheets, with the judgment to know when a figure looks wrong.

  • Genuinely AI-native. You already use these tools daily and reach for them first when work repeats.

Nice to have

  • Experience as the ops person at a company between 15 and 60 people.

  • Exposure to venture-backed company operations: fundraising processes, board reporting, cap table administration.

  • Experience working across multiple entities, currencies, or employment systems, particularly UK and Germany.

  • Familiarity with Xero, payroll platforms, HRIS (Personio, Bob) and expense tools, Carta, Notion, or Google Workspace.

  • Real interest in AI, machine learning, computer vision, 3D technology, or deep tech.

At SpAItial, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure all candidates are treated fairly throughout the recruitment process.

title: Revenue Operations Executive
description:
The Company

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.

With 70,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of events, memberships, and learning products, we help individuals and teams grow faster in their careers.

We’re ambitious, we move quickly, and we’re still early in the journey — which means real ownership, fast progression, and the opportunity to build things from scratch.

The Role:

This role is for someone who thrives on solving tricky business challenges with technical tools and solutions, someone who's happy to proactively lead projects that drive change and impact, working across a mix of functions, teams, and stakeholders. You'll need to work at pace while still keeping a sharp eye on the details, going beyond what’s being asked to focus clearly on the ‘why’ of what we do.

You'll work across tools like HubSpot, Salesforce and Clay helping us keep the data behind our marketing, sales, and customer teams accurate and trustworthy. From dashboards and lead routing, to pipeline hygiene to helping manage our workspace, you'll play a critical role in how smoothly our engine runs day to day.

This role is for someone who enjoys translating business processes and challenges into automations, tools, and workflows that supercharge operations. It's for someone with some experience getting systems to talk to each other, who drives impact proactively, identifies opportunities independently, and sees them through.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Championing CRM Integrity & Data Hygiene: Ensure our data ecosystem remains accurate and trustworthy, driving high-quality standards across our platforms (includes record deduplication, field standardization, and correcting data inconsistencies).

  • Driving Data Enrichment: Transform raw data into actionable insights, proactively identifying patterns or anomalies that inform our strategy.

  • Managing Tool Ecosystems & Access: Serve as a gatekeeper for our tech stack, ensuring secure, efficient, and appropriately permissioned access for all team members.

  • Strategic Reporting: Build and maintain the visibility our Sales and Marketing teams need to make informed decisions via Hubspot and Salesforce.

  • Orchestrating Process Automation: Translate business challenges into seamless, high-impact workflows, keeping our internal processes running smoothly (includes lead assignment routing, Salesforce Flow maintenance, and HubSpot workflow management).

  • Integrating Systems: Connect our technology landscape to create a unified data flow between tools (webhooks, APIs, Zapier).

  • Ensuring Deliverability Excellence: Protect and optimize our communication infrastructure, ensuring our outreach reaches its destination (includes monitoring sending domains, IPs, and email authentication protocols).

  • Securing our workspace: Provide essential technical support for our workspace security and user management.

 
 

This Role Is For You If…

  • You have strong attention to detail and a genuine care for data accuracy.

  • You're comfortable working with data and data hygiene best practice

  • You have hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce, as well as building out integrations, automations and pipelines with these as part of the tech stack

  • You work in a methodical, process-driven way, and you're willing to follow and improve documentation.

  • You communicate clearly and would rather ask a question than guess.

  • You're curious about how business systems connect, and you've got some experience getting them to talk to each other.

And..

  • You have exposure to marketing operations, sales operations, or a data role.

  • You're familiar with automation tools or basic scripting.

  • You're interested in APIs, integrations, or light coding.
